script: The expansion of the universe is speeding up. Astronomers discovered this in 1998 by studying distant exploding stars. The discovery won the Nobel Prize in Physics in 2011. Whatever is causing it is called dark energy. It seems to make up about 68 percent of the universe. Nobody yet knows what dark energy actually is.
